# Didik Tri Susanto

> Backend-focused product engineer with 13 years of experience, including 6 years remote. Builds usable, scalable systems across fintech, social commerce, education, and AI. Based in Malang, Indonesia. Open to backend and product engineering roles, remote-friendly.
